component.name: Wordloom
component.summary: A writing studio for novels and long-form work

description.p: Wordloom organises a book into a binder of chapters, scenes, characters, places and research, with a corkboard, an outliner, snapshots, project-wide undo and a story-timeline Gantt chart. It compiles the manuscript to EPUB, DOCX, HTML, Markdown or plain text.

ul.li: Binder, corkboard (grid or freeform, with sticky notes), outliner and a split editor with styled Markdown
Story timeline with dependencies, conflict detection and swim lanes
Character relationship map and character / place sheets
Research files: images and PDFs inside the project
Plain-text project format that works with git and backup tools
